self_reported_concerns: The workflow’s Regal step disables `directory-package-mismatch`, `no-defined-entrypoint`, `with-outside-test-context`, `unconditional-assignment`, and `line-length` because this bundle must stay in `package main` for Conftest and the test helpers intentionally use `with input as ...` over bundled policies.

`SCP-R-003` uses the canonical token `scp:vendoring-attested` with manifest-specific equivalents: a boolean JSON key in `package.json` and comment markers in `pyproject.toml` / `go.mod`. ADOPT-001 §11 did not expose a stronger canonical marker line beyond that token, so the implementation standardizes on the shared token across the three manifest syntaxes.

The `SCP-E006` no-manifest observability record is written with `expires_at: "2099-12-31"` so it remains valid against `schemas/policy-check-summary.schema.json`, which requires an `expires_at` date on every `disabled_rules` entry.
